WCF Select Insurance Company 
WCF National Insurance Company 
California Schedule Rating Plan 
Effective: October 1, 2022 
 
 Range of Modifications 
Risk Characteristics Credit  to Debit 
Classification Peculiarities 
Exposure variation due to technology, employee distribution, fit in class, grade in 
class, assignment by analogy. 
20% 20% 
Employees 
Selection and hiring, training, experience, controls, supervision, benefits, wage 
levels. 
20% 20% 
Medical Controls 
First aid, emergency and disaster plans, prompt injury reporting, MPN participation, 
litigation management, return-to-work programs. 
10% 10% 
Premises / Work Environment 
Physical condition, hazards controlled, housekeeping, documented inspection and 
preventive maintenance (including records of corrective action), industrial hygiene, 
ergonomics, workplace design, workflow, resource distribution, and administrative 
controls. 
15% 15% 
Safety Devices and Equipment 
Type and condition, guarding, lockout/tagout, personal protective equipment, 
inspection and maintenance, MSDS available, required training with 
documentation. 
10% 10% 
Management Safety Organization 
Demonstrated management commitment to providing a safe work place, safety 
programs, compliance with company safety recommendations, communications, 
safety culture. 
5% 5% 
Safety Organization 
Demonstrated commitment to safety through activities such as accident 
investigation and analysis with corrective action, record-keeping, safety committee 
organization and effectiveness, employee involvement. 
10% 10% 
Maximum +/- 50% 
 
 
1. The minimum premium which qualifies for scheduled rating is $500 estimated annual modified manual 
premium (modified manual premium = manual premium after the application of experience modification). 
 
2. The schedule rating factor is applied in a multiplicative manner after the application of the experience rating 
modification (if the risk is experience rated) and before the application of the premium discount. 
 
3. The credit or debit must be within the range for a specific risk characteristic as provided in this plan. 
 
4. The effective date of the schedule rating factor must be on or after the date of the carrier’s receipt of the 
documentation supporting the basis for the schedule rating factor. 
 
5. At the time that the schedule rating factor is applied, the carrier must have documentation on file detailing the 
basis for the credit or debit.
